Job Description
Engineer, IAM, Chennai/Pune
We are looking for an Identity & Access Governance Engineer with strong experience in cloud identity governance, modern authentication and enterprise IGA. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in Microsoft Entra ID or comparable cloud identity platforms, with experience across access governance, Conditional Access, SSO/federation, MFA, passwordless authentication, hybrid identity and application integrations. A solid understanding of SailPoint and identity lifecycle governance is required. The role will also contribute to identity modernization, NHI governance, automation and AI-powered IAM capabilities.
Responsibilities:
Cloud Identity & Governance
Design, implement and continuously improve cloud identity governance and access controls.
Manage identity governance across users, groups, roles, applications and privileged identities.
Define and maintain RBAC and least-privilege models.
Review identity architecture and identify governance, security and operational gaps.
Support identity modernization and cloud/platform transformation initiatives.
Establish scalable governance standards that can operate across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
Entra ID & Modern Authentication
Manage and enhance Microsoft Entra ID identity and access capabilities.
Design and govern Conditional Access policies.
Support MFA, Passwordless, Passkeys/FIDO2 and modern authentication.
Govern enterprise applications, application registrations, service principals and permissions.
Support identity risk, privileged access and access hygiene improvements.
Support AD and Entra hybrid identity environments.
NHI & AI-Agent Identity Governance
Drive discovery and governance of Non-Human Identities, including service accounts, service principals, managed identities, workload identities and application identities.
Support discovery and inventory of AI agents and autonomous identities.
Define governance requirements around ownership, lifecycle and access for AI agents and NHIs.
Review roles, permissions and entitlements assigned to AI agents and machine identities.
Apply appropriate least-privilege and access-review principles to human, machine and agent identities.
Identify unmanaged, orphaned, stale or over-privileged NHIs and help drive remediation.
Help establish governance models for the growing use of AI agents and machine-to-machine identities.
Automation & AI-Powered IAM
Automate IAM/IGA activities using PowerShell, REST APIs, scripting and workflow automation.
Identify opportunities to use AI-powered automation for identity governance and operational activities.
Automate identity discovery, governance reporting, lifecycle processes and control validation where appropriate.
Help build scalable and repeatable identity governance processes rather than relying on manual administration.
Qualifications
Must have: Strong hands-on experience in Microsoft Entra ID / cloud identity governance, including Conditional Access, MFA, passwordless/passkeys, RBAC and application identities.
Strong Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) knowledge, including JML, provisioning/deprovisioning, access reviews, roles and entitlement governance.
Working knowledge of SailPoint and enterprise identity governance processes.
Experience delivering identity migration, modernization or transformation progra

Your Role
As a Systems Engineer / Solutions Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, integrating, validating, and optimizing complex enterprise IT systems that support healthcare imaging solutions, including PACS and Radiology Informatics.
You will collaborate with R&D, Product Engineering, Architecture, and Customer Support teams to translate business and technical requirements into scalable, secure, reliable, and high-performing system solutions.
This role requires a strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure technologies, combined with expertise in systems engineering, solution design, technical integration, and problem-solving across complex IT environments.

Systems Design & Architecture: Design and define end-to-end technical solutions for enterprise healthcare imaging systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, security, and performance.
Requirements Analysis: Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into system specifications, architecture designs, and integration plans.

Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with global R&D, software engineering, product management, and customer-facing teams throughout the product development and deployment lifecycle.

Job TitleSystems Product Industrialization Engineer

Job Description
Systems Product Industrialization Engineer

As an Ultrasound Systems Product Industrialization Engineer, you will help turn new R&D designs into products that can be manufactured safely, consistently, efficiently, and at scale.
You will work directly with R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, Test Engineering, and suppliers to bring new Ultrasound Systems into production, implement design and process changes, and remotely help to solve technical problems encountered on the manufacturing floor.

Partner with R&D and Manufacturing to transition new and modified Ultrasound System designs into production.

Create and maintain Process FMEAs, manufacturing control plans, process requirements, assembly instructions, validation documentation, and other controlled manufacturing records.
Create and release Manufacturing Bills of Materials, routings, and associated manufacturing master data.
Remotely troubleshoot technical issues on production lines and help restore production quickly when manufacturing problems result in line-down conditions.

Apply Lean Manufacturing and continuous-improvement methods to reduce waste, simplify processes, improve cycle time, increase yield, and lower manufacturing cost.

Identify and communicate manufacturing risks to R&D and project teams, including challenging designs or schedules when product quality, manufacturability, safety, or compliance could be compromised.

Bachelor's Degree / Vocational Education in Mechanical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Sciences, Cost Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Lean Manufacturing, Industrial Automation or equivalent.

Experience of 4 years or academic exposure to manufacturing engineering, Lean Manufacturing, Process FMEA, process validation, root cause analysis, DFM/DFA/DfX, engineering change control, manufacturing documentation, or cost analysis is beneficial.

We are looking for an early-career engineer who combines solid engineering fundamentals curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn.

title: Solutions Engineer (AI, Identity & Data Security)
text:
About WhiteMatter

WhiteMatter is the first agent-native company that secures and operationalizes the agentic enterprise across the entire agent lifecycle. Foundation models are non-deterministic, so protecting agents only at runtime leaves every decision to the last millisecond and every alert to the security team. WhiteMatter treats AI as a deployment problem first: every agent is assessed, governed against policy, and deployed from an approved blueprint before it reaches production; every action it takes is decided before it executes; and every outcome is proven after it runs. Founded by security veterans and deployed across, WhiteMatter is headquartered in Austin, Texas. Make every agent matter. 

Why Join Us

We are building the infrastructure that makes safe, autonomous AI a reality for the enterprise. Joining our team means tackling unsolved engineering and security challenges at the absolute cutting edge of agentic AI. We operate with high velocity, value ownership, and are backed by top-tier investors. If you want to shape how the world's most advanced AI systems are governed and deployed, we want you on board.

About the Role

The Sales Engineer is the technical authority and narrative driver in customer engagements. This role is responsible for translating complex AI, Identity, and Data Protection challenges into defensible, real-world solutions—while helping customers understand not just how something works, but why it matters. This role blends deep hands-on technical expertise with storytelling, big-picture (“paint the picture”) thinking, and collaborative problem solving. You will work with prospects to obtain the technical win by designing a viable technical solution with an amazing product that can be applied to various scenarios. You will operate across AI security, LLMs, AI agents, MCP, DLP, and Identity, partnering closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering to close deals and influence product direction.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Discovery & Storytelling  

Lead technical discovery for AI security, DLP, and Identity-driven use cases.  

Translate complex security architectures into clear narratives that resonate with:  

○ CISOs and VP’s  

○ Security leaders  

○ Architects  

○ Engineers  

○ Business stakeholders  

“Paint the big picture” by connecting AI usage, identity trust, and data protection into a cohesive story.  

Clearly articulate what problems are solvable today, what are partially solvable, and what are structural limitations.  

Architecture & Solution Design  

Design and present end-to-end architectures covering:  

○ LLM and AI agent workflows (human + non-human identities)  

○ Data protection, inspection, and policy enforcement  

○ Identity, authentication, authorization, and trust boundaries  

Build, configure, and run demos and POCs using Dockerized components.  

Integrate enterprise environments including:  

○ Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Okta  

○ Microsoft Intune, Jamf Pro  

Explain and demonstrate AI pipelines using:  

○ LangChain, LangGraph  

○ MCP-style agent orchestration patterns  

Lead deep dives into DLP architectures, including:  

○ What DLP can realistically detect and enforce  

○ Where traditional DLP breaks down (AI, agents, encrypted channels, context loss)  

○ Common false assumptions customers have about DLP coverage  

Help customers understand enforcement gaps, bypass scenarios, and risk trade-offs without overselling.  

Workshops & Collaborative Problem Solving  

Facilitate technical workshops and brainstorming sessions with customer teams.  

Co-design architectures and controls with customers rather than prescribing static solutions.  

● Whiteboard flows covering:  

○ AI access paths  

○ Identity trust boundaries  

○ Data movement and enforcement points  

Use workshops to uncover real constraints and drive solution alignment.  

Execution & Field Innovation  

Troubleshoot complex issues across AI pipelines, identity flows, and data

title: Audio Video Engineer
text:
Company Description

Job Description
Nielsen Consumer Neuroscience is the market leader in bringing neuroscience expertise to the field of consumer research. Our methodology looks at advertising, branding, product development, packaging, and entertainment. Nielsen Neuro brings world-class experts in neuroscience and marketing from U.C. Berkeley, MIT, Harvard, and the Hebrew University to develop better methods of understanding consumer thought, emotion, and behavior.
Nielsen Consumer Neuroscience clients include Fortune 100 companies across multiple categories, including automotive, consumer packaged goods, food and beverage, financial services, Internet, retail, and many more sectors. Entertainment category clients include major companies in the broadcast, cable television, and motion picture industries. Nielsen Consumer Neuroscience is a wholly owned subsidiary of Nielsen.
Key Responsibilities:
As an Audio Video Engineer, you will be responsible for multiple facets of the research pipeline, helping to facilitate study preparation and fielding objectives, based on approved study designs and guidance from our science team. This position has the following areas of focus:
Reviewing, preparing, and/or modifying static images, audio files, and/or editing or producing videos. The requirements vary by study, and may include assets provided by clients, agencies, or assets created in-house with standard AV equipment. This may include, but is not limited to, photography, videography, photo editing, image manipulation, audio recording, audio editing, and/or video editing.
Modifying experimental control software scripts using basic scripting logic based on approved study design documentation. Some additional study preparation responsibilities involve modifying study templates and generating output.   
Collaborate with Neuro teams - neuroscientists, coordinators, fieldwork teams to meet the study timeline requirements.
Other creative assignments assigned by the internal teams may involve creating promotional materials, videos, or marketing related assets.

• Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent on-the-job experience – with experience in media production / communications studies / digital media
• 2 years minimum experience in Photoshop or similar program, manipulating images, using layers, color correction, masking, image retouching, determining resolution, dpi, and ability to conform image assets to provided standards
• 2 years minimum video editing experience in Adobe Premiere or similar editing suite like Avid or FCP. Ability to import footage, batch capture, edit on timeline, insert graphic overlays, titling, audio manipulation, exporting, transcoding and conforming video assets to provided standards
• 2 years minimum experience in video production using HD video cameras, 3-point light kits, wired/wireless mics, tripod, etc. Familiarity with DSLR still photography using a light tent and video   capture will be advantage
• Attention to detail and excellent organizational skills
• Strong communications skills – English proficiency required and ability to communicate through email or phone calls to global teams in English.

• Fast learner, resourceful self-starter, with ability to self-direct and self-manage on projects, while following detailed study-design protocols
Other Preferred Skills
• Ability to troubleshoot AV equipment and PCs workstations for common errors, fixes and workarounds, and general technical problem-solving skills.
• Familiarity with scripting or programming logic. Familiarity with languages like Python, HTML, C#, PHP or Java is a plus. Programming skills are not necessary. [training provided]
• Experience with other creative media platforms like Adobe After Effects, 3DS Max or Maya, animation software, etc.
